description: Source file implementing telemetry data model APIs, including functions for getting and setting report profile parameters, handling JSON and MsgPack blobs, and querying memory usage.

methods.name: Telemetry_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters related to report profiles, including JSON and MsgPack blobs, and temporary report profiles.

methods.name: Telemetry_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets string parameters for report profiles, processing JSON and MsgPack data, and updating internal blobs accordingly.

methods.name: Telemetry_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves unsigned long parameter, specifically total used memory.
